intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: A leaf is turning slow circles beside Nerelle. It shows no sign of leaving.

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “It has been waiting there for several minutes. I suspect an appointment.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “I don’t recall issuing permits to leaves.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: A second leaf drifts up and settles in behind the first. Then a third.

options.labelText: “Put up a sign: *Back after the tide.* You’re off duty.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Back after the tide. The council would never.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She tells the leaves. They drift off politely, one at a time, in order.

options.labelText: “Keep the first one! Press it and frame it. First official leaf of your reign.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Then the other two will want frames.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: The queue grows by a twig.
